questions.explanation: B is correct. Rule: each number is squared. 4² = 16; so 7² = 49. Verify: 4→16=4²; 7→49=7² ✓. Trap: 42 = 7×6 (no systematic link); 56 = 7×8 (no pattern); 35 = 7×5 (no pattern).

B is correct. Rule: n → n(n+1). 5 → 5×6 = 30. Similarly 8 → 8×9 = 72. Verify: 5→30=5×6 ✓; 8→72=8×9 ✓. Trap: 64 = 8² (wrong rule — 5²=25≠30); 80 = 8×10 (wrong: multiplier should be n+1=9 not 10); 48 = 8×6 (uses same multiplier as n=5, ignoring that it must change).

C is correct. Rule: n → n². 9² = 81. So 12² = 144. Verify: 9→81=9² ✓; 12→144=12² ✓. Trap: 108 = 9×12 (multiplies the two numbers — no pattern link); 168 = 12×14 (wrong: would be n(n+2) but 9×11=99≠81).

B is correct. Rule: n → n³ + 1. 3³+1 = 27+1 = 28. So 4³+1 = 64+1 = 65. Verify: 3→28=27+1 ✓; 4→65=64+1 ✓. Trap: 65 is the only option satisfying n³+1; 48 = 4×12 (random); 80 = 4×20 (random); 60 = wrong.

C is correct. Rule: n² → n+1 (square root of the first number, then add 1). 121 = 11² → √121+1 = 11+1 = 12 ✓. 169 = 13² → √169+1 = 13+1 = 14. Trap: 13 = √169 only (forgets to add 1); 16 = √169+3 (wrong adjustment); 17 = 13+4 (no pattern).

C is correct. Rule: n → n×(n+1). 7×8 = 56. So 9×10 = 90. Verify: 7→56=7×8 ✓; 9→90=9×10 ✓. Trap: 81 = 9² (wrong rule—9²=81 but 7²=49≠56); 72 = 9×8 (uses fixed multiplier 8 instead of n+1=10); 108 = 9×12 (wrong multiplier).

C is correct. Rule: n² → n. 16 = 4², so 4; 81 = 9², so 9. Equivalently: n → √n. √16 = 4; √81 = 9. Verify: 16→4=√16 ✓; 81→9=√81 ✓. Trap: 27 = 81/3 (wrong: 16/4=4, relationship is square root not division by a fixed number); 8 = wrong square root.

A is correct. Rule: n → n²−1. 6²−1 = 36−1 = 35. So 8²−1 = 64−1 = 63. Verify: 6→35=36−1 ✓; 8→63=64−1 ✓. Equivalently: n → (n−1)(n+1) = 5×7=35; 7×9=63. Trap: 64 = 8² (forgets to subtract 1); 72 = 8×9 (uses n×(n+1) rule which doesn't fit 6→35: 6×7=42≠35).
C is correct. Rule: n³ → n (cube root). ∛125 = 5; ∛512 = 8. Verify: 5³=125 ✓; 8³=512 ✓. Trap: 9 = ∛729 (729≠512); 6 = ∛216 (216≠512); common error is mistaking cube root for square root.
B is correct. Rule: n → n². 15² = 225. So 13² = 169. Verify: 15→225=225 ✓; 13→169=169 ✓. Trap: 156 = 13×12 (no rule connection); 182 = 13×14 (no pattern); 196 = 14² (uses 14 instead of 13).
